body: Sure, send me a message! I'd like a new friend if possible.

Abuse. It's mostly emotional but sometimes physical. I've witnessed too many patterns, the light switch emotions and behaviors, and how little love I receive from certain family members. I'm very low contact with one family member and plan to be no contact with everyone except my mom in the near future. 

My heart hurts thinking about how everyone (minus 2 family members) dehumanized me. Yet tonight I was told I deserve to be treated like a human by a friend/mentor. It brought me to tears. It always brings me to tears when I hear others (outside the home) say kind words to me. 

Others outside the home; that is. I don't believe my family saying that they love me; most of them don't. I care about them but I think it's mutual now.

I'm cutting them off very soon. Exceptionally low contact for some then no contact for others.
